cases.title: One unreadable pit link record is skipped and named once at U; the other pits still load; the damaged record is left exactly as it is
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 1 Nov 2026 from the PR
cases.expected: The damaged PIT_LINK record on pit 109D56 reads back as DMGBROKEN2A4 after the setup and still after two LINE + U rounds. The command line holds exactly one line starting '[CE] The CE link record on one pit (drawing handle 109D56, at ' and ending 'could not be read, so CE skipped it and loaded the rest. That pit may not drag its pipes when it is moved; its record has been left as it is.' The Civil log holds exactly one '[Link] BUG-1141: pit 109D56 has a link record that cannot be read; skipped by the cache rebuild and left as it is.' No other pit is named. MOVE of pit P2 says '1 found' and nothing names P2.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit test reads ten records in memory; only AutoCAD runs the real rebuild at U over every pit in a real drawing and writes to the real command line.
not_automated: SEEN by Codex: after the MOVE of pit P2 (109768) by 0,2000 its pipe end(s) follow the pit (the robot cannot read a CE pipe object's points). Also SEEN: pit P3 itself is not dragged on a MOVE (the PR says every other reader still reads as before, so the damaged pit stays undragged until repaired).
